# laravelforge_org_storage_provider (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge organization storage provider by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the storage provider.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.

### Read-Only

- `assume_role` (Boolean) Whether an EC2 assumed IAM role is used instead of access/secret keys.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Storage provider type (`s3`, `spaces`, `hetzner`, `ovh`, `scaleway`, `custom`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `directory` (String) Directory (path prefix) within the bucket.
- `endpoint` (String) Custom S3-compatible endpoint URL.
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the storage provider is currently used by a backup configuration.
- `name` (String) Display name of the storage provider.
- `provider_name` (String) Human-readable provider name (e.g. `Amazon S3`).
- `region` (String) Storage region.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
